Thank you for your response. I'm unsure how to start a network project.
You might find this instructional video from [company_name] helpful. Video: Network project

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking help with networking multiple [product_name] modules (all sharing the same [article_no]), and is unsure about how to set up communication between them. Another forum participant confirms this is possible, suggesting a network project and referencing required software versions, as well as an instructional video. There is a clear knowledge gap regarding how to initiate and configure the networking setup for these modules.
